long_biography.plain_text:
Decorative craftsmanship provided Griffinson's first entrepreneurial platform in Canada. A fifth-generation painter, he established a Vancouver company in 1989 after apprenticing in the family trade. The business expanded traditional European techniques into high-end interiors, restoration and specialist finishes, eventually passing day-to-day leadership to his eldest daughter and extending the craft into a sixth generation.

A separate passion for rebuilding wooden boats opened a second career. Griffinson converted that practical experience into a commercial expedition service, preparing the operation for passenger safety standards and beginning private charters in 2004. The venture combined his hands-on technical knowledge with the intimate, small-scale hospitality of guided coastal travel.
